label: America becomes the oil capital and Hormuz goes obsolete
description: A sequence in which Iranian oil facilities are annihilated, the Strait of Hormuz becomes obsolete, everyone comes to buy oil from America with a train of tankers, Venezuelan oil is used and Cuba is next, followed by Greenland mineral deals. Hormuz still carries about a fifth of world oil, and Cuba has negligible reserves, which is the weakest link in the sequence. He puts most of it as questions rather than statements.
